domain: Moral Psychology / Philosophy of Autonomy / Political Theory of Power
topic_summary: An essay arguing that Lukes's three faces of power (decision-making, agenda-setting, preference-shaping) and Elster's adaptive preference formation describe a single self-directed mechanism: constraints on a person converge, over time, into felt preferences, such that a chosen rule and an adapted preference become introspectively indistinguishable. The essay claims the only way to recover the distinction is behavioral re-exposure testing, not introspection, and sorts interventions by the 'clock' of the pressure they defend against (jurisdiction for seconds, pricing for months, formation for a life).

key_entities: Jon Elster (adaptive preference formation, 1983; Ulysses and the mast)
Amartya Sen (capability approach; tamed housewife, hopeless beggar)
The fox (Aesop; sour grapes / sweet lemons)
key_claims: Three instruments exist: formation (change wants), pricing (change cost, leave choice), jurisdiction (change whether choice reaches you)
The instruments interconvert unidirectionally: pricing and jurisdiction both decay into formation over time
Social norms convert pricing into formation fastest, which is why norms feel like values
Introspection cannot distinguish a chosen preference from an adapted one once formation has completed
The distinguishing evidence survives externally as counterfactual behavior (re-exposure), not as introspective report
A rule 'works' precisely when it becomes painless, and painlessness is indistinguishable from adaptation
Interventions should be matched to the pressure's timescale: jurisdiction for seconds, pricing for months, formation for a life
Adaptation is diagnosable by timing correlation (new taste arrives exactly as the option closes), not by cost
The framework helps unequally: cheap and sufficient at the fast end (scams), and least useful precisely where formation has already succeeded (Sen's hard cases)
key_tensions: Consent-based preference formation (chosen rule) vs circumstance-imposed preference formation (adaptation) — introspectively identical, behaviorally distinguishable only under counterfactual re-exposure
Lukes's political/interpersonal power vs the essay's self-reflexive collapse of operator and target into one body
Awareness-as-defense (cheap, sufficient for reconnaissance against fast threats) vs awareness-as-powerless (Sen's hard cases, where the option to test was never available)

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: The stabilized shared commitment is that a preference's authenticity is a fact about the person that can, in principle, be adjudicated — the question 'is this mine' is treated by every party in the essay as a real, answerable question, and the essay's authority rests on delivering the correct adjudication procedure (re-exposure/counterfactual behavior) rather than on the reader's introspective say-so.
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Interpretive legitimacy is claimed by whichever procedure can correctly sort 'preferences your circumstances shaped without your consent' from 'preferences you shaped on purpose' — the essay explicitly nominates behavioral counterfactual testing as that procedure and disqualifies introspection as a rival authority ('reports are the thing under suspicion').

readings.commitment: A preference is authentically yours if and only if it would survive being handed back its foreclosed alternative — authenticity is defined entirely by dispositional behavior under counterfactual re-exposure; there is no fact about authenticity beyond what this test would reveal.
readings.authority_grounding: empiricist/behaviorist — introspective report is inadmissible evidence; the essay's own explicit position
readings.expected_structural_delta: Victim set includes anyone whose world will never hand the option back (Sen's cases) — for them the question is permanently unanswerable, not just currently unanswered. Authenticity collapses into a purely dispositional, testable property with no residual first-person fact.

readings.commitment: A preference is authentically yours if it is held with genuine reflective endorsement — the 'I'm glad I don't want it' vs 'I didn't want it anyway' distinction is real and detectable in a properly disciplined first-person examination, even if ordinary introspection is often sloppy or confabulated. Endorsement is a genuine mental state, not merely a report to be discounted.
readings.authority_grounding: phenomenological/first-person authority — the tradition the essay explicitly argues against ('surely you'd feel the difference') but does not fully refute, only asserts is unreliable
readings.expected_structural_delta: No one is structurally excluded from authenticity-verification in principle, since the test is (claimed to be) introspectively available in some refined form; the beggar and housewife are not definitionally locked out the way the counterfactual reading locks them out. Beneficiary shifts toward whoever already has articulate reflective access; victim shifts toward those whose introspective reports are systematically dismissed as confabulation regardless of accuracy.

readings.commitment: A preference's authenticity is fixed by its causal history at the moment of formation — whether it arose from autonomous deliberation or from externally imposed constraint — and this is a fact about the past, not about future dispositions. Even if no test can ever recover it, the fact exists and was determinate at the time; the timing-correlation probe is diagnostic evidence for this historical fact, not a redefinition of what authenticity consists in.
readings.authority_grounding: historical/causal — the essay's own diagnostic move ('ask when it showed up') read as evidence-for-a-fact rather than constitutive-of-the-fact
readings.expected_structural_delta: Authenticity can be permanently unknowable (epistemically) while still being fully determinate (metaphysically) — this reading tolerates irrecoverable facts, whereas the counterfactual reading denies there is any further fact once the test is impossible. Produces a different victim structure: the tamed housewife has a determinate authentic/adapted status even though no one, including her, can ever access it — she is not merely 'untestable,' she is a fact no one can reach.

readings.commitment: The authentic/adapted distinction is the wrong question to adjudicate for the hardest cases; what matters morally is not sorting preferences into 'yours' or 'installed' but expanding the option set itself. Sen's tamed housewife is not owed a verdict on whether her preferences are authentic — she is owed capabilities. Applying the authenticity test to her is itself close to a category error, a diagnostic imported from cases (doorstep, diet) where it does no harm, onto a case (structural deprivation) where the correct response is redistribution of options, not epistemology of the will.
readings.authority_grounding: capability-approach / political-economic — Sen's own explicit departure from preference-based welfare evaluation
readings.expected_structural_delta: Reframes the beneficiary/victim structure entirely: under this reading, the essay's own closing move ('awareness is the last thing that's free') is itself a mild trap, since it offers the deprived person a verdict about their interior life in place of the option they actually lack. Victim set is anyone for whom 'know your preference's origin' substitutes for 'receive the missing option.'

axiom_contradictions.basis: The counterfactual reading holds that there is no fact about authenticity beyond what the re-exposure test would reveal (verificationist axiom); the genealogical reading holds that authenticity is a determinate historical fact independent of any test's ability to recover it (realist axiom). A framework cannot simultaneously assert that authenticity just is dispositional-testability and that it is a fact that can outrun all possible tests.

The counterfactual reading treats introspective report as categorically inadmissible ('reports are the thing under suspicion'); the endorsement reading treats a disciplined introspective state as constitutive of authenticity itself. One cannot hold both that first-person access is definitionally disqualified from bearing on the fact and that it is the very locus where the fact consists.

The capability reading holds that the authentic/adapted question is the wrong question for hard cases and ought to be replaced by option-expansion (an anti-realist-about-relevance axiom: the fact, even if it existed, wouldn't matter morally); the genealogical reading holds that the historical fact of origin is exactly what matters morally, independent of whether options are ever restored. A framework cannot hold both that the authenticity fact is the morally load-bearing variable and that pursuing it is a category error distracting from the variable that actually matters.

axes.structural_delta: Authenticity is constituted by (not merely evidenced by) behavior under hypothetical re-exposure; no further fact exists once the test is impossible.
axes.primary_observable: Whether the subject would retain the preference if the foreclosed option were restored, measured behaviorally

axes.structural_delta: Authenticity is a genuine first-person mental state (endorsement vs defensive report), recoverable in principle by disciplined introspection.
axes.primary_observable: Qualitative difference between endorsement-affect and defensiveness-affect under careful self-report protocols

axes.human_readable: Reading: Authenticity as Determinate Historical Fact
axes.structural_delta: Authenticity was fixed at the causal moment of formation and is a fact independent of any test's ability to recover it — timing-correlation is evidence, not constitution.
axes.primary_observable: Historical/causal record of what preceded preference-formation, in principle reconstructible from documentation, testimony, or circumstance, even if in practice often lost

axes.human_readable: Reading: Authenticity-Talk as Category Error for Deprivation Cases
axes.structural_delta: For structurally deprived subjects, the authentic/adapted sort is the wrong evaluative target entirely; the correct response is expanding the option set, not adjudicating the will.
axes.primary_observable: Presence or absence of an expanded capability set for the subject, independent of any verdict on preference origin

axes.human_readable: The Tempo-Margin Regime (Matching Instrument to Pressure Clock)
axes.structural_delta: A structurally independent claim from the kernel: that correct instrument-selection is governed by a matching relation between rule-revision-speed and pressure-duration (the 'tempo margin'), and that mismatch in either direction (too fast = collapses to intention; too slow = calcifies into coffin) is a distinct failure mode from misidentifying which reading of authenticity is correct. This axis concerns *instrument engineering*, not *what authenticity is* — it survives even if one is agnostic among all four kernel readings.
axes.primary_observable: Ratio of rule-revision-difficulty to pressure-duration (seconds/months/life-scale), observable via cases like indissoluble marriage, diets, doorstep policies
axes.selection_reason: Passes §3 independence test against the kernel: the tempo-margin claim concerns HOW FAST an instrument should revise and is fully coherent under any of the four authenticity readings — a genealogical-origin theorist and a capability theorist can both accept 'indissoluble marriage has zero margin' without resolving what authenticity consists in. Different primary observable (revision-speed ratio) from any reading's observable (dispositional test / endorsement affect / historical record / capability set). Retained as the sole additional non-kernel axis; the essay's other candidate structural claims (jurisdiction-as-folded-power, norms-as-fast-lane-conversion) were tested and found to be restatements of the kernel's authority-grounding question rather than independent structure (see fracture_scan and omegas).

deferred_axes.structural_delta: The essay's move of collapsing Lukes's operator/target distinction into a single body when applied to the self
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Tested against the kernel and found to be Type A overlap (drift-generated): this is simply a restatement of 'who has authority to adjudicate' from a different angle — it is the authority_description question, not a new observable. Folded into commitment_system_recognition.authority_description rather than emitted as a separate axis.

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Social norms convert pricing to formation faster than money-based pricing does
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Causally downstream restatement of the kernel's central claim (instruments interconvert into formation) rather than an independent structural axis; no distinct primary_observable survives separation from the kernel readings' own observables. Retained only as omega material.

omegas.description: A skeptical reader could argue all four readings collapse into one under sufficient pragmatism (e.g., 'test what you can, redistribute where you can't, use judgment about origin where evidence exists') — treating them as complementary heuristics rather than mutually exclusive foundations. The axiom_contradictions above were checked against the selectivity test (would accepting one require rejecting another's axiom) and held, but the boundary between 'complementary heuristic' and 'contradictory foundation' is itself contestable and not fully closed by this analysis.

The essay's central move — folding Lukes's operator/target distinction into one body for self-directed power — is a genuine interpretive extension not present in Lukes 1974, which was exclusively about interpersonal/institutional power. Whether this extension is faithful appropriation or category mistake (self-jurisdiction may not behave like political jurisdiction because there is no genuine second party whose grievance can be prevented) was not resolved and bears on how much weight the whole framework can carry.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium) — the essay operates entirely within a first-person register even when importing third-person political theory

omegas.description: The essay's own closing move acknowledges that awareness is nearly powerless for Sen's hard cases, which is structurally identical to what the capability_traction_reading argues at the level of the whole kernel — the essay may already contain its own strongest kernel-critique without naming it as such. Flagged because this raises the question of whether the essay's authorial voice is best read as endorsing the behaviorist_counterfactual_reading throughout and merely gesturing at its limits, or as already conceding ground to the capability_traction_reading without fully adopting it.

The claim that social norms convert pricing to formation faster than money does (the essay's 'fast lane' claim) was deferred as non-independent structure, but it may deserve its own generation cycle in a future pass, since it makes a specific comparative-mechanism claim (speed of conversion, not just direction) that the tempo_margin_regime axis does not fully capture — tempo_margin concerns instrument-selection given a pressure clock, not comparative conversion rates between instruments.

fracture_scan.notes: F01 flagged: the essay presents itself as resolving the authenticity question via re-exposure/counterfactual testing (behaviorist_counterfactual_reading), but close reading of its final section on Sen's hard cases shows the essay itself gesturing toward the limits of that reading without fully adopting an alternative. The kernel decomposition treats the essay as containing a live, unresolved contest among four readings rather than as a settled advocacy piece for one reading, which is the more defensible construal but requires noting that a naive reading would take 'ask when it showed up' as the essay's final, uncontested answer. Recorded as omega_sen_case_asymmetry rather than treated as a fracture requiring re-extraction, since the ambiguity is present in the source text itself, not introduced by this analysis.
